component.name: Sqlion
component.summary: Editor SQL e navegador de bancos de dados

description.p: Sqlion is a fast native database client for SQLite, PostgreSQL, MySQL/MariaDB, SQL Server and MongoDB.

ul.li: Database navigator with tables, views, procedures, functions and triggers
SQL editor with highlighting, autocompletion, formatting and IDE shortcuts
Editable result grid, export and import, ER diagrams
Auto, Manual and Smart transaction modes
Projects stored in folders, ready to be versioned with git
